whatIs.question: What is Vaitu?
whatIs.answer: An app for handing off jobs you can't take. If you've been booked for a job and can't make it, you publish it, colleagues apply, and you pass the job to the candidate you choose.

name.question: Where does the name come from?
name.answer: From the Italian "vai tu", which means "you go".

audience.question: Who is it for?
audience.answer: Professionals who work at weddings and need to pass on a job they can't take: photographers, videographers, musicians, DJs, planners and make-up artists. Other professions will follow.

publish.question: How do I publish a job?
publish.answer: Start a new job and fill in the details, or describe it by voice and let the app fill in the fields. You also set the application deadline and the maximum size of your shortlist.

apply.question: How do I apply?
apply.answer: Open a job and tell the poster why you're the right person for it. You need a name on your profile, plus a website, social page or phone number, and you can apply until the deadline.

choose.question: How do I choose a candidate?
choose.answer: Open the applications you received, add the most promising ones to your shortlist, then assign the job to the winner. The job closes and the other applicants are rejected.

contact.question: How do we get in touch?
contact.answer: The poster sees each applicant's website or social page and phone number, and contacts the winner there. Vaitu has no chat.

payments.question: Does Vaitu handle payments or contracts?
payments.answer: No. You agree the fee and terms between yourselves. Vaitu only records the amount you both confirm, and asks each of you afterward whether it was settled.

changeMind.question: Can I change my mind?
changeMind.answer: Yes. Applicants can withdraw, even after winning, and the poster then picks someone else. Posters can edit their jobs, and reopen one that is closed or assigned.

ranks.question: What are ranks?
ranks.answer: You earn points for the jobs you do and the reviews posters leave, and lose them by dropping a job you won or not showing up. They take you through the bronze, silver and gold ranks. Posters see your rank, reviews and badges when you apply.

notifications.question: How do notifications work?
notifications.answer: The app tells you about new jobs for your professions and regions, new applications, decisions and changes to jobs you applied to. You can also allow push notifications on your device, and manage alerts and emails in Preferences.

leave.question: How do I leave?
leave.answer: You have two options in your profile. Deactivating hides you and can be undone by signing in again: your open jobs are deleted and your applications withdrawn, and we email you a link to erase the account for good. Deleting erases your account straight away. Reviews and past job records stay, without your name, as [Deleted User].

report.question: How do I report someone or something?
report.answer: Use the report button on a job, an applicant or a review. You can also block someone: you stop seeing each other's open jobs and can no longer apply to them. You can undo a block in Preferences.
